An '''''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] protected the dayside [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the Imperial-held [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Along with a secondary [[Unidentified Imperial II-class Star Destroyer (Gall, nightside)|Star Destroyer]] patrolling Gall's nightside orbit, this [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] defended the moon against a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Gall|attack]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].
